description: This file defines the I18NGroupAPI class, which provides REST API endpoints for managing internationalization (I18N) groups within the OrangeHRM administrative module. It includes methods to list all I18N groups with support for sorting and pagination, but other CRUD methods are not implemented. The class leverages traits and dependencies for localization service integration and follows OpenAPI annotations for API documentation.
